hi.description: Use **?hi** to greet the user and ask how staff can help.
hi.message: hello! thank you for reaching out. how can we assist you today?

wait.description: Use **?wait** to tell the user that their ticket is still being reviewed.
wait.message: please wait while we find the appropriate staff member to handle your request.

askproof.description: Use **?askproof** to ask the user for evidence such as screenshots, message links, or IDs.
askproof.message: could you please send any evidence you have, such as screenshots, message links, user IDs, or other relevant details?

askid.description: Use **?askid** to ask for the relevant user's Discord ID.
askid.message: could you please send the Discord user ID of the person involved?

resolved.description: Use **?resolved** to tell the user that their request has been resolved.
resolved.message: your request has been resolved. is there anything else i can help you with?

deny.description: Use **?deny** to tell the user that their request cannot be fulfilled.
deny.message: unfortunately, we are unable to fulfill this request. is there anything else i can help you with?

partneraccept.description: Use **?partneraccept** in a partnership ticket to send a partnership acceptance response.
partneraccept.message: your partnership request has been accepted. thank you for reaching out to us!

partnerdeny.description: Use **?partnerdeny** in a partnership ticket to send a partnership rejection response.
partnerdeny.message: unfortunately, we are unable to accept your partnership request at this time. thank you for reaching out to us.

appstatus.description: Use **?appstatus** in an internals ticket to tell the user that their application is still under review.
appstatus.message: your application is still under review. thank you for your patience while we take the time to review it.
